description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimulus types used in a study, as indicated by the central label “Stimulus Type.” The chart contains seven slices, representing different categories of stimuli. The largest slice, labeled “Draft/Other,” is red and accounts for approximately 26.4% of the total. “Press Release” is represented by a yellow slice at 18.7%, while “External News Article” is a dark blue slice at 18.1%. “Email” is a green slice representing 2.7%, and “Event Posting” is a purple slice at 6.6%. “Organizational Report” is a dark teal slice at 7.7%, and “Organizational Website” is a navy slice at 4.9%. Finally, “Intra-agency news article” is a light blue slice at 4.9% and “Interview” is a brown slice at 8.8%. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice, and a legend is not present. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
